reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: function exists at migration L7 and has a live non-test caller in src/app/kiosk/page.tsx:34. Gate 2: no trust_assumptions defined in BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json; attack vector is the unauthenticated anon RPC endpoint, which is untrusted by definition. Gate 3: supabase/migrations/ is explicitly in_scope and race condition in record_attendance_by_card is listed in key_security_concerns. An attacker (or a malfunctioning NFC reader) can trigger this by sending two concurrent anon RPC calls to attendance.record_attendance_by_card with the same card_id; under PostgreSQL READ COMMITTED both transactions read the same v_last_type before either commits, compute identical v_new_type values, and both INSERTs succeed — corrupting the user's in/out state machine with a duplicate attendance record of the same type. Severity retained at High: the vulnerability directly compromises the integrity of the core attendance state machine for any affected user, and is reachable without authentication.
